title: NanoGPT Slowrun: 10x Data Efficiency with Infinite Compute
cleaned_content: This research introduces "NanoGPT Slowrun," a technique demonstrating 10x data efficiency in training LLMs by leveraging what is termed "infinite compute" (meaning, ample computational resources). The method prioritizes reducing the required training data by an order of magnitude, at the expense of potentially longer training times, offering a critical trade-off for data-scarce domains or reducing data acquisition costs. This has implications for training smaller, specialized models more effectively.

title: MacBook M5 Pro and Qwen3.5 = Local AI Security System
cleaned_content: This discussion highlights the practical application of running a Qwen3.5 LLM locally on a MacBook M5 Pro to create an on-device AI security system. Leveraging Apple's M-series chips enables efficient, private, and low-latency inference for tasks like video analysis or anomaly detection without cloud dependency. This demonstrates the growing feasibility of deploying powerful LLMs for sensitive, real-time edge computing applications, enhancing data privacy and operational independence.
